subject.title: Feature request: All-time cumulative usage & cost view (a "lifetime bill")

question: Should CodexBar add a first-class lifetime ledger, and should it show durable usage history separately from retention-limited local cost estimates rather than as one authoritative bill?
rationale: This introduces a new user-facing billing surface whose data sources have different completeness, privacy, and persistence guarantees; code review cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped lifetime view
options.body: Add a dedicated local-history view with explicit coverage labels and separate usage-history and estimated-cost sections.

options.title: Keep rolling windows only
options.body: Decline the lifetime surface because its coverage caveats would make the displayed total too easy to misinterpret.

options.title: Defer to broader cost design
options.body: Wait until the related model and cross-provider aggregation direction settles the needed cost semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped lifetime view
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated local-history view with explicit coverage labels and separate usage-history and estimated-cost sections.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged cost-window implementation and its remaining-scope note were authored by steipete.
